'''2010 Dagobah Regionals Stephen Morgan DS Imperial Entanglements (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Morgan]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements (V) / No One To Stop Us This Time (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)|OVS15-50-Imperial_Entanglements-remaster.webp|label=Imperial Entanglements (V) / No One To Stop Us This Time (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' IE(v) 2010
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
